verdict.rationale: Brevo documents unlimited automated, multi-step workflows that run on their own, triggered by events like form sign-ups, contact scores, or optimal send times. That is background automation the product itself provides, not just a one-off scheduled send. The evidence is marketing-level first-party copy, and nothing shows AI tools such as the MCP server being able to create or configure these automations. Missing for 10: in-depth workflow/automation docs (trigger types, conditions, monitoring), evidence that AI agents can set up automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Create an unlimited number of automated, multi-step workflows to engage users at key moments along their journey.
Automatically trigger follow-up emails as soon as someone signs up.
Get contact scores based on engagement, purchases, and behaviors to trigger automations or create targeted segments.
Automatically send emails when each contact is most likely to engage.
